A small home, typical of the town.  Small windows dot each wooden wall of the dwelling, while oaken shingles cover the roof.  One door is visible, as is a singular chimney.  A very old woman sticks her head out of the house and looks in your direction.

She looks directly at Jerek.  "Honey?  Is that you?  It's me, Syrra, your long lost love."  Jerek takes a step back.  "No, you are not.  If you were Syrra you would be 10 years my junior.  How is it you know me, ma'am?"  The old woman looks...

...confused.  "I do not know.  All I know is that you are Jerek and I am Syrra."  "You may be Syrra's grandmother, if anything!  Now enough with this crazy talk!  Go back to your weaving, old woman!"  The old woman runs into the house, crying.
Out of the corner of your eye you think you saw a man  of middle age comfort her as the door closes.
She smiles pleasantly and shuts the door.
Nothing seems to happen.
What would you like to do?
The once overwhelming sense of magic which was once there is now gone.

A lovely young lady and a small boy burst out of the home.  "Jerek," she cries.  "I told you it was me!  Now it is all clear.  An evil magic-user cast a spell on this whole place to disguise what it truly is.  Now that the spell is broken you will...
...see the inhabitants for who they truly are!  Orcs!  Now we must flee, before we are discovered!
Too late!  A band of orcish warriors and goblin Shamans reign arrows into the party!
The orcs surround you rapidly, draw their weapons and attack.  Syrra and Jolon run into the house for safety.  The battle is on.

The orcs and goblins lie dead.  The curse is removed from the town and it has been cleared of it's evil residents.  One by one, townsfolk, once cursed as old and senile, come out of their homes as younger, stronger adults.  Hugging and kissing...
...is commonplace.  Nice job.  The town is once again at peace.

Syrra and Jolon come out of the house and embrace Jerek.  "Jerek, my love.  It has been years since we have last embraced.  But I tell you this, I feel the same love and compassion now as I felt the first time we embraced so long ago."  Jerek blushes.

"Syrra, my love, I have waited for this day to come for a long, long, time.  I feared you dead, but in my heart I had hope.  Now we are reunited and my life can be happy again.  We have our friends to thank."  He turns to you, "Thank you.  I will...

...remain here with my wife and son to catch up on our lives and make a new one here.  I will sell the old shop and open another here.  If you ever need anything, you see me."  He turns after a hearty hand shake, and heads into his new home, to begin...
...his life anew.  After watching the three wave through the window, you move on.
A sign hangs in the window, "For Sale by Jerek.  See me at the new leather shop in OldWyn."

Jerek and Syrra greet you at the door.  Jolon can be seen running and playing along the side of the house.  Jerek speaks, "We've still had a few orcish raids, but nothing major.  Only a few show up at a time.  Please, come in, re-fit with whatever...
...you need.  You all will recieve a significant discount."
Orcs!  They have hidden out in the mountain valley undetected until now.  They sound an alarm and attack.
The alarm has brought more orcs upon you.
The orcs lie dead.  To the south a makeshift village awaits.
The archers must have called this shack home.  A bunch of bows and arrows litter the floor.  Most of them useless, but some of value.
The warriors hut.  A few weapons and shields lie about.
Under a straw mat you find a hole in the sand.  In the hole is a small pile of coin collected from the orc's victims.
The captain's hut.  One of the captain's is still here, furiously scrawling a letter.  He drops his quill and attacks with great ferocity.

Having killed the last captain around, you examine the letter he had.  "Larg, the campaign continues on schedule.  OldWyn has been dealt with, as has the alliance with our goblin bretheren.  I will keep you.....We have just been attacked.  send...."
There are a few coins scattered about, along with some weapons.
That is all you find in the room.
There is nothing of interest in the room.

A lovely young lady and a small boy burst out of the home.  "You have lifted the curse!  Now it is all clear.  An evil magic-user cast a spell on this whole place to disguise what it truly is.  Now that the spell is broken you will...
...see the inhabitants for who they truly are!  Orcs!  Now we must flee, before we are discovered!

The woman and her son rush out of the house.  "Thank you for protecting us.  That was the last of the orcs and goblins.  We will be safe, for now.  But there are rumors of orcs aligning with goblins and together they are set on taking over.
I hope someone can stop them.  I wish we knew where the twins are!  They could stop this."  She takes her son and heads inside.
The young woman waves to you as you pass.

A strange man is sitting by a campfire.  In swirling robes seeming to change color as they swirl, he looks up at you.  "Been to the guardian of the trees, have you?  You have come here to learn of the warp in time.  I know of such a place.

A place exists where time and space have ripped, allowing the future to pour into our land.  It has brought terrible machinery into our midst.  Breathing fire.  You must stop this beast or it will surely destroy us.  You must also seal the rip with...

...this."  He holds up a strange staff.  Plunge the staff into the time rip.  That will seal it forever.  Return here when you have done so.  But beware.  These fire-breathing machines are tough to kill.  You must find something from its time to...
...destroy it with or you stand little chance of succeeding.  Good luck.  This time warp area is just north of the town which has been under siege by bats."  He hands you the staff.
The strange man jumps up from his seat, "The rip is not sealed!  Go back and seal it at once, or we are all doomed if the orcs and goblins figure out how to control this machine!"

The strange man slowly rises from his seat, "The rip is sealed.  Good work.  The battle was hard, I am sure.  But now we are safe as the orcs and goblins will not have the luxury of controlling these beasts for their own gain.  Here is your reward."
"I am no longer needed here.  Good bye."  A swirling wind engulfs you and the strange man.
When the dust settles, the strange man, the campfire, everything, is gone.  You stand in an empty cave.
A small, glowing hole is seen here in the side of the rock face.  Incredibly strong magic eminates from it.  What do you do?
The staff slides completely into the small hole.  A swirling, suction type noise engulfes the rock face.
After the commotion settles down, the hole is sealed and the rock face appears normal again.
Nothing seems to happen.
A dirty, weather-beaten sign reads, "BEWARE - Brontavia acid pits.  Enter at your own risk."
This cell holds a badly beaten goblin.  He is near death.  He growls something about death to humans before he passes out.
Office of the sergaent-at-arms of Ruwar.  He looks up at you, "You have the wrong office.  Good day."
Office of the Captain.  He looks up at you and says, "Excuse me, but you seem to be in the wrong place.  Please leave."  Do you?
"Do you have a loss of hearing?  I said leave my office at once.  It is private.  If you do not I will place you under arrest."  Do you leave?
The Captain does as he promises.  He pulls a cord hanging next to his right shoulder and within 10 seconds 40 guards pour down the corridor.  You are taken into custody and hauled away.
You are tossed into a 10'x10' cell.  The guard explains, "45 day sentence.  Good day."
The guard shows up and lets you out.  "Now.  You are welcome to explore if you like, as I hope you have learned your lesson."  You think you have.
This door is locked.
A small door slides open and food is shoved through, along with enough water to keep you alive.
This door is locked.  You hear muffled cries from behind it.  What do you do?
Success.
Doesn't work.  Now what?
The lock pops open and you go inside.
The door opens and you go inside.

A young lady of 20 years old is crying here.  She gathers herself and says, "My name is Nika.  I have been arrested because I took money from the church.  I only took it because my family was going hungry.  Now my family will starve.  Please, will...
...you go and feed them?

"Thank you.  Just get them some food and they should be able to live until I am released in a month or two.  Thank you.  I will remember this."  She gives you a map of the house where she lives.  She sees you out and locks herself back in the cell.
"I understand.  She sniffles a little, then all out balls.  It's okay.  I'm sure they will live without fod for ANOTHER MONTH OR TWO!"  She pushes you out and locks up the cell.

A thin man and two kids sit on the porch.  The child looks up at you, "Do you have any maney?"  The father quickly scolds the child and ushers him inside.  You hear the child say,  "But we are hungry, and mom is in prison!"  THe dad shuts the door.
The house is locked up tight, but you see the child in the window, chewing on a loaf of old, moldy bread.
The thin man is on the porch with the boys.  Do you get his attention?

"Yes, may I help you?"  the man asks.  You tell him you have spoken with his wife and she is well, and she has asked you to help him and his family.  The man looks off into the distance.  "Yes, she stole.  It was not the right thing to do.  I blame...

...myself.  I haven't been able to work since the orc attack.  Took over a year to recover, and I'm still not all the way.  Another 3 months, I'll be good as new.  It's mighty nice of you to help us out.  We won't forget it."  You toss him some food...
...and get underway again.

The woman is here, with her husband and two sons.  She recognizes you.  "Good day to you!  I told you I would not forget.  I have been working as a seamstress and have gotten pretty good at it.  Here, take this.  Someone traded me for some clothes....
....and I don't have the foggiest idea what it is.  All I know is I don't have a use for it."  She hands you a strange shield.
"Have a safe trip.  Stop by anytime!"  She closes the door.
The family is playing outside the house, laughing and having a great time.  You are happy you could be of help to them.

The woman from the prison cell is here, rocking alone on her porch.  She sees you and scowls, "My family is dead because you didn't feed them!  Now I am alone.  Go away!  What are you, anyway?  Not heroes!"  She slams the door.
A huge iron gate is locked.  What do you do?
An open, unlocked door is easily passable.
A proud flag flies high and true.
A beautiful priestess comes to you.  "How may I soothe thy wounds?"
A strong, hulking man opens up the door, "Welcome to the best magic shop and weapons store in the land.  Help yourselves.  My quality is top notch and so are my prices."
The town's well, providing fresh, clean water for its inhabitants.
You spot a small band of orcs scouting out this home.  Do you take them on?
You jump the orcs outside the home in the bushes.  The battle is on.

The orcs lie dead.  A woman peeks her head out of the window and sees the carnage, "Oh my goodness!  THe orcs have discovered Wellton Parish!  What are we to do?"  She runs out of the house to you.  "Brave indeed.  How can I repay you?  I know."
She reaches into her pocket and pulls out a ring.  "Take this.  I have no use for it."  She gives it to you.  You take it with thanks and move on.
A larger house on the outskirts of town is being scouted by goblins.  Care to get rid of them?
The goblins lie dead.  No one is in this house at the moment.
A large wooden base has a ladder running some 50 feet to the tower.  The gusrds call down to you, "Good day!  Please stay clear of the towers.  Thanks you."
Some 50 feet in the air, these large towers hold 4 guards.  You see 2 archers and two swordsmen.

An old, old man in a green robe emerges from his home.  You see from his weathered face and deep, penetrating blue eyes this man has seen a lot in his day.  "Greetings.  Welcome to Arl.  My name is Retyu.  I have heard of your coming.  You have a...

...tough quest before you.  Many perils will be in your way.  But do not hesitate or be discouraged.  Go with your first instinct, it is usually right.  I was once in your shoes.  Young, foolish, ready for everything and anything.  My good friends...

...Cindred, Zulea, Thyrr, Lluellyn, Denvar.  You remind me of us so long ago.  Do you know if you have what it takes?  You better know.  If you have doubts you will surely fail.  Good luck to you in your quest.  My gut tells me you will succeed.
And I always go with my gut.  Good day."  Retyu shuts the door behind him, and his house blends in with the scenery and disappears.
A nice, white house.  A woman is sitting on her porch, hanging fresh linen over the railing to dry.
A simple home.  Through the window you see a mother rocking in a chair with a small boy sleeping on her lap.
A larger, yet simple home.  You notice a small girl tied up in the middle of the floor, and a small boy fending off a few orcs with a table knife!  Do you help them out?
You burst into the house.  The orcs run out the back door, scooping up the boy as they do.  Do you tend to the girl or go after the orcs?
Tend to the girl.
Go after the orcs.

You untie the girl.  She shouts at you.  "You idiots!  Don't bother with me!  I'm fine.  Go get my brother!  Do I look like I'm kidnapped?  No.  Does my brother look kidnapped?  Yes.  Jeez."  She sits on a chair and cries.  Not so much from fear as...
...frustration.  I suggest getting after those orcs, who are probably gone by now.

You show the boy home.  The girl is elated.  "Shelnas.  I'm so glad you are okay.  Now get to your room.  Mom and dad will be very angry when they hear this story."  She turns to you.  "Thank you for saving my brother.  Now please go before my mom...
...and dad get home.  They'd be really mad at me.  Here, my dad gave this to me, and now I give it to you.  Thank you again for saving my brother."  She gives you a necklace.
You except your gift and grant the girl her wish.  You discreetly leave the home before mom and dad get home.
You run past the tied up girl and out  the back of the house.  You see the orcs dart into the forest.  You get after them.

With your waiting to get the girl freed, the orcs have had plenty of time to prepare an ambush for you.  They spring it now.  The battle is on.  You see the little boy pull his knife from his boot and go on the offensive.
The orcs lie dead.  Now, where did that little boy go to?  You wonder if he is alright.

The little boy runs over to you and tugs on your leg.  What a brave boy!  You see yourself in his tiny face.  But no boy should have to see what he just saw, let alone take part in it!  You tuck him under your arm and head back to his house.
You find the body of the little boy mixed amongst the bodies of the orcs.  What a waste.  Such a small boy dying in such a horrific way.  You wonder what you could have done better to save him.

You bring the body of the little boy home.  The little girl is just sickened.  "How could this happen?  How could this happen?  Where did these orcs come from?  Why!?!"  She grabs her little brothers body and runs up the stairs.  There is no more...
...to be said or done here.  You have failed in this task.
You catch up to the orcs here.  They stop running and make their stand.  You see the little boy pull a table knife out of his boot and join the attack!
A lovely woman in a red dress lets out a scream.
"Get out of here at once or I will call the guards."  Do you leave?
You make a hasty retreat.
The woman does as she promises.  Guards fill the room.  "You have no right to be in here.  You must leave at once.  Do you comply?"
The guards escort you out of the room and give you a stern warning about tresspassing.  You go about your business, but are under severe scrutiny.
The guards attack you.
More guards fill the room.
Bodies litter the floor.  The guards lie dead.  The woman runs out the door screaming bloody murder.
Someone has stored their valuables here.  Do you want to take them?
You steal the posessions.
Someone is going to be upset about this.
Some food.
Yum.  Bottles of fine wine.
Someone has their gold stored here.  Take it?
You slam the door open and take her hostage.  She struggles momentarily and then gives up.  You can keep her under control while you check out the room.
She closes the door.  She locks the door.
"You are here to remove items from storage?  What is your name please?"
Nothing seems to happen.
You apoligize and close the door.
"Vorchaz?  Yes, here it is.  And your security authentication password?"
"Guardian?  That's correct.  Thank you.  Go ahead please and help yourself to your things."  She lets you pass.
An old sarcophogus is here.  It is inches thick covered in dust.  It must have been here forever.  Do you open it?
The lid slides off.  Unfortunately for you, it is the home of a mummy.  It attacks you.
You have killed the mummy.  Inside the sarcophogus are some items.
It doesn't budge.
A rack of books.  Nothing of interest.
This must be the storage room for Count Vorchaz!  But when you open the sacks, they are empty.  He must be storing his items someplace else!
The chest is empty.
Piles of useless, old equipment of no value.
The bed is fresh.  Hasn't been slept on in awhile.
Empty.
A beautiful statue portraying man pondering his future.
You notice the head of the statue actually twists and could be opened at the neck.  Care to open it?
Inside the neck of the statue is a sword.  A nice sword.
You screw the head back on the statue and leave.
Guards fill the room.  "You have no right to be in here.  You must leave at once.  Do you comply?"
The racks of books here are all about history.  Do you want to read up on a little history?

The book tells the story of the birth of the twins.  It tells how peace ruled the land under their guidance.  Alone they were much weaker than when they are together.  It also states how the twins disappeared not too long ago and trouble started.
The old man is here.  "So, you need guidance.  I shall give you some."
"The mercenary guild has jobs to complete.  Who knows where that could lead you."
"Count Vorchaz is a powerful man who has a lot of wealth."
"If you find yourself getting nowhere, try looking around with a little more intensity.  Search for things."
"Keep your friends alive for as long as you have them.  They can open doors for you which you may not have known existed without their presence."
"There are very magical items in this land which have laid untouched for centuries.  Find them"
"Both the Prince and the Queen are looking out for some interests.  But those interests are unknown."
The old man sees you out.
The gate to the graveyard opens easily.
You pass through as it closes behind you.
This ancient tombstone reads, "Trevor Numthum - 814  - 837. "
The oldest tombstone in the graveyard.  It is unreadable.
A family of four is buried here.  Killed last year by a group of orcs raiding the village.
A band of undead creatures is roaming the road, looking for victims.  They find you.
An ancient woman greets you.  "I am a gypsy healer.  How may I help you?"
A bunch of orcs are hiding out in the woods.  They see you and attack.
Having dispatched the orcs, they had a small stash.
A quick search of his body reveals some coins.
You call over the guard for assistance.  He asseses the situation, "Okay.  Got a drunk here.  Let's get him outta here."  They take him away.

What a sight.  A beautiful rug fills the room.  A pretty elite group hangs out here.  The few patrons are smoking cigars and chatting quietly.  You seem a little out of your element here.  But, you've been out of your element before.
"Good day to you.  Enjoy your visit."
"Welcome.  Care for a cigar?"
"Here you are.  Enjoy your stay."  He hands you a cigar.  What a magnificent specimen.  This must be from that far off land of Cyluba.  A Cylubian cigar.  You put it in your pack.
Ahhh.  Wonderful.  Tastes magnificent.  You take a few drags and extinguish it.
"Welcome.  Enjoy your visit to our wonderful Inn."
The door is locked.
Dumin speaks up, "This is it.  This is my room."  He opens it up and you go inside.
The lock pops open.
Nothing seems to happen.
You drop the drunkard into his chair.  He falls fast asleep.  The desk looks open and there are some interesting papers there.  Do you want to read them?

Dear Dumin,  You are hereby exiled from our race as you continue to ally yourself with the humans and their half-breed bastard races.  Do not return home.  Ever.  We are not kidding.  Really.  Sincerely,  Dnawd
The desk looks open and there are some interesting papers there.  Do you want to read them?
Hidden inside the bed are some scrolls.  Do you want to take them?
As you are packing away the last of the scrolls, a magic user walks into his room and spots you.  He realizes what you are doing and attacks.
The wizard is dead.  You can continue your thieving.

As you turn to leave the room, the owner of the scrolls appears.  He sees what you were going to do and is impressed by your decision.  "You are a wise lot.  I would have been forced to kill you had you taken my scrolls.  But, I would like to join you.
May I?"
"Wise decision.  I will be of great assistance to you.  The name is Cindrel."  He packs up his scrolls and falls in line.
In the desk is a dagger.  A nice dagger.

Ponburk has been badly wounded.  His remaining men comfort him.  He manages to speak.  "Thank you.  I was innocent.  I would have been found guilty for sure.  I was set up by the Captain of the guard, Kolarin.

He was secretly plotting against the mayor to overthrow him very soon.  But we don't have time to talk now.  Meet me at the guild outside the city gates.  We can talk then.  But be careful, there are more guards around now then ever,

and once word gets out that you have aided in my escape, you will be attacked at every opportunity.  Godspeed to you.  Here is how you find me."  Ponburk gives you a map and then leaves, making his way back to the safety of the guild.
